stem: Meena's torch stops working. She opens it and looks at the small incandescent lamp inside. Under which condition can the lamp glow again when the torch is switched on?

options.text: The filament inside the glass bulb is unbroken and joined to both terminals of the cell.
The glass bulb of the lamp looks whole from the outside, even if the filament is broken.
The filament is broken, but the lamp is tightly fixed in its holder.
The lamp is new, but its filament is fused and does not carry current.

teacher.key_rationale: An incandescent lamp glows only when current passes through an intact filament. Options B, C and D all describe a broken or fused filament, in which case the lamp cannot glow, so A is the key.
